units.rawText: Prof, we're back!
units.displayText: Prof, we're back!

spans.text: Prof, we're back!

units.rawText: The Sandbox Barrier is back online. The battle went very well, thanks to your help.
units.displayText: The Sandbox Barrier is back online. The battle went very well, thanks to your help.

spans.text: The Sandbox Barrier is back online. The battle went very well, thanks to your help.

units.rawText: Croque's gone off to repair the rest of the Oasis' systems. She's also preparing to reallocate more operands to strengthen the Barrier.
units.displayText: Croque's gone off to repair the rest of the Oasis' systems. She's also preparing to reallocate more operands to strengthen the Barrier.

spans.text: Croque's gone off to repair the rest of the Oasis' systems. She's also preparing to reallocate more operands to strengthen the Barrier.

units.rawText: Yes. Also, all the remaining Sanctifiers inside the Sector have been wiped out, so it seems the battle in the Middle Ring went very well too.
units.displayText: Yes. Also, all the remaining Sanctifiers inside the Sector have been wiped out, so it seems the battle in the Middle Ring went very well too.

spans.text: Yes. Also, all the remaining Sanctifiers inside the Sector have been wiped out, so it seems the battle in the Middle Ring went very well too.

units.rawText: You've helped us turn the tables once again. Thank you.
units.displayText: You've helped us turn the tables once again. Thank you.

spans.text: You've helped us turn the tables once again. Thank you.

options.rawText: You guys worked hard too. Go get some rest.
options.displayText: You guys worked hard too. Go get some rest.

spans.text: You guys worked hard too. Go get some rest.

options.rawText: Oh, this was par for the course. No need to flatter me.
options.displayText: Oh, this was par for the course. No need to flatter me.

spans.text: Oh, this was par for the course. No need to flatter me.
(Nod.)

units.rawText: Don't worry, Professor. We've already been healed. It'll be fine.
units.displayText: Don't worry, Professor. We've already been healed. It'll be fine.

spans.text: Don't worry, Professor. We've already been healed. It'll be fine.

units.rawText: Please don't say that, Professor. You saved the entire Oasis. I need to express my gratitude. Thank you.
units.displayText: Please don't say that, Professor. You saved the entire Oasis. I need to express my gratitude. Thank you.

spans.text: Please don't say that, Professor. You saved the entire Oasis. I need to express my gratitude. Thank you.

units.rawText: That said, I think I went a bit overboard in the battle just now.
units.displayText: That said, I think I went a bit overboard in the battle just now.

spans.text: That said, I think I went a bit overboard in the battle just now.

units.rawText: In any case, it'll take a while before we can return to peak condition.
units.displayText: In any case, it'll take a while before we can return to peak condition.

spans.text: In any case, it'll take a while before we can return to peak condition.

units.rawText: Uwah! How come everything went dark?!
units.displayText: Uwah! How come everything went dark?!

spans.text: Uwah! How come everything went dark?!

units.rawText: It seems Croque shut down the Oasis' systems. Looks like the repair work is almost done.
units.displayText: It seems Croque shut down the Oasis' systems. Looks like the repair work is almost done.

spans.text: It seems Croque shut down the Oasis' systems. Looks like the repair work is almost done.

units.rawText: Once it's complete, we should be able to gradually reactivate the systems that went offline during the Sanctifier attack.
units.displayText: Once it's complete, we should be able to gradually reactivate the systems that went offline during the Sanctifier attack.

spans.text: Once it's complete, we should be able to gradually reactivate the systems that went offline during the Sanctifier attack.

units.rawText: System preparations complete (Safe Mode).
units.displayText: System preparations complete (Safe Mode).

spans.text: System preparations complete (Safe Mode).

units.rawText: D-Don't be scared, if you're scared you can hold my hand.
units.displayText: D-Don't be scared, if you're scared you can hold my hand.

spans.text: D-Don't be scared, if you're scared you can hold my hand.

units.rawText: Still, we'll have to trouble you to sequentially reactivate each of the rebooted systems with your access privileges, Professor.

spans.text: Still, we'll have to trouble you to sequentially reactivate each of the rebooted systems with your access privileges, Professor.

units.rawText: I've already made the arrangements for the upcoming events. We'll be counting on you, Professor.
